objective: Validate a repeated, non-labor, self-service developer pain before expanding the existing migration acquisition asset.

threshold.conclusion: cluster verified; manual-time threshold and willingness to pay remain unverified

cluster: Responses API and Open Responses tool-loop state/serialization failures that cause 400s, lost reasoning, duplicate items, or unrecoverable tool errors

issues.signal: aborted stream loses function_call; next output gets 400
reasoning items dropped during tool-loop replay
previousResponseId client tool call loses its function_call
tool errors invalid when an output schema requires JSON-string output
MCP approval emits duplicate item with previousResponseId

inference_boundary: Issue bodies verify repeated technical failures and nontrivial reproductions, but do not verify buyer identity, a 30-minute median repair time, or willingness to pay.

executed_output.type: browser-local free diagnostic extension to the existing migration acquisition route

intervention.baseline: saved version 28 had a legacy migration checker and tracked US$9 product CTA but no tool-loop JSON preflight
intervention.success_condition: after explicit deployment approval, observe qualified checker use and at least one verified attributed product sale within the effect window
intervention.withdrawal_condition: do not create a separate paid product unless direct buyer intent or a verified sale appears; after three measurement windows with no movement, change customer/channel/price layer

revenue_impact.reason: saved but not deployed; no buyer-intent or sales evidence

evidence_quality: primary public issue pages plus exact source/test/version read-back
